text: Domain & services (L2) leaves open (todo) whether the audit is realised by a backend.service slot or by the server itself. The package realises it in the ui-kit-component-tools server (pure function auditUiKitComponents fed by the bound read operations); the contribution declares only backend.mcpServer. Also: the page leaves the formal codes of the two audit refusals open (todo in 6o1rfh21); the package uses NOT_FOUND (slug without a record, HTTP 404 through the proxy) and VALIDATION (unknown rule, HTTP 400). The host operation catalog got a plugin row audit_ui_kit_components (read, idempotent; cli n/a; rest via the generic proxy) so read-only profiles admit it.
